Side, then total, then moneyline13 games with fair line, market line and difference in separate columns, plus the order recorded in the dataOur line and the market's agree within 2.5 points on 2 of 13 games and differ by more than 5 on 9 - the disagreement is the finding, not an edgeThat a 5-point gap is skill rather than the model ignoring who is availablemeasuredorigination →

Signal separate from stakingTwo boards that are never combined, plus a seeded simulation of the same edge under two staking rulesIdentical edges produced a bankroll of 178.18 under flat staking and 16.79 under proportional staking, from the same 100-unit start: the signal never changed, only the staking didClosing-line value, the metric the signal board is built on - blocked, because no price has ever been taken at stake timepartly blockedsignal vs staking →

Score the number, not the bankrollSkill separationProfit is a slow, noisy statistic. Beating the closing number is faster and much harder to fake, so it carries the ranking weight.signal-vs-staking.htmlofficial results ↗
